title: No Will Costs Your Family $47,000 and 18 Months
hook: Sixty percent of Americans have no will — and when they die, the government decides who gets everything, then sends your family a $47,000 bill for the privilege.
angle: Estate planning is the most-avoided financial topic — but the cost of avoidance isn't abstract, it's a concrete 5-figure probate fee and 18 months of legal limbo that hits families when they're already grieving
audience: Adults 30-65 with any assets — house, savings account, retirement accounts — who have never made a will
key_numbers: $47,000 average probate cost on a $600K estate (roughly 8% of estate value)
$100-500: cost of a basic online will
3-8% of estate value consumed by probate fees
